title: 送风头罩怎么用
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/18_PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPPMENT FOR COVID19.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/18_PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPPMENT FOR COVID19/src.py

points.K7: 披肩：去污再用，溢洒就换

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一个白色送风头盔，对镜头打招呼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a white powered respirator helmet and greets the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学用电动送风头罩。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现一个日历图标，翻到几年前
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon beside the panda mascot flips back a few years.
shots.narration: 原片拍于疫情期间，有些是当时做法。

shots.scene: 小研站在更衣间里，看着架子上的头盔和电池
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in a changing room looking at a helmet and battery pack on a shelf.
shots.narration: 小研下周要进高等级实验室。

shots.scene: 小研拿起头盔，翻来覆去，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the helmet and turns it over, puzzled.
shots.narration: 这个头罩，她还是第一次用。

shots.scene: 王老师走进来，把电池和腰带放到台面上
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks in and puts a battery pack and a belt on the counter.
shots.narration: 王老师说：一步一步来。

shots.scene: 一套送风呼吸器摆在台面：头盔、披肩、导线、电池、腰带
shots.prompt_en: A full powered air purifying respirator set on the counter: helmet, shroud, cable, battery pack and belt. No people.
shots.narration: 这是电动送风过滤式呼吸器。

shots.scene: 头盔特写，背后有一个过滤盒
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the helmet with a filter cartridge mounted at the back. No people.
shots.narration: 头盔上装着过滤器，

shots.scene: 过滤器把小红点挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: The filter blocks small red dots from getting through. No people.
shots.narration: 能滤掉绝大部分病原体。

shots.scene: 王老师提起头盔，下面垂着一圈白色披肩
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator lifts the helmet, with a white shroud hanging down around it.
shots.narration: 下面连着一圈披肩，盖住头颈。

shots.scene: 剖面图：空气从头盔一侧进入，穿过过滤器
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram: air enters one side of the helmet and passes through the filter. No people.
shots.narration: 空气从一侧吸进来，过滤器滤一遍，

shots.scene: 风扇图标，干净气流从额头往下吹过脸
shots.prompt_en: A fan icon, with clean air flowing down from the forehead across the face. No people.
shots.narration: 风机再把干净空气往脸上吹。

shots.scene: 气流从披肩下沿向外流出
shots.prompt_en: The airflow escapes outward at the lower edge of the shroud. No people.
shots.narration: 头罩里始终有风往外走。

shots.scene: 电池盒特写，导线连到头盔
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a battery pack with a cable leading to the helmet. No people.
shots.narration: 风机靠电池带动。

shots.scene: 小研在腰间系上黑色腰带
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fastens a black belt around her waist.
shots.narration: 第一步，系好腰带。

shots.scene: 小研拉紧腰带调整松紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the belt strap to adjust it.
shots.narration: 松紧现在就调好，

shots.scene: 连体防护服罩住腰带，腰带被盖在里面
shots.prompt_en: A coverall closes over the belt, hiding it inside. No people.
shots.narration: 穿上防护服后，就够不着了。

shots.scene: 电池盒上的电量灯全亮
shots.prompt_en: A battery pack with all its charge lights on. No people.
shots.narration: 每次实验前，电池要充满。

shots.scene: 小研把电池卡到腰带一侧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clips the battery pack onto one side of the belt.
shots.narration: 然后把电池挂到腰带上。

shots.section_title: 披肩：去污再用，溢洒就换
shots.scene: 白色披肩特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the white shroud attached to the helmet. No people.
shots.narration: 原片的披肩，去污后可以再用，
overlay: 披肩：去污再用，溢洒就换

shots.section_title: 披肩：去污再用，溢洒就换
shots.scene: 披肩上一滴液体溅上，旁边新披肩替换的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A splash lands on the shroud, and an arrow shows it being swapped for a new shroud. No people.
shots.narration: 但一旦被溢洒污染，就换新的。

shots.section_title: 披肩：去污再用，溢洒就换
shots.scene: 日历图标和说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a manual icon. No people.
shots.narration: 能否重复用，以现行规定和说明书为准。

shots.scene: 小研把导线插进头盔接口，拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student plugs the cable into the helmet socket and twists it tight.
shots.narration: 接好导线，插紧拧牢。

shots.scene: 头盔内部的头箍旋钮特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the headband adjustment knob inside the helmet. No people.
shots.narration: 头盔里的头箍，调到合适的松紧。

shots.scene: 小研穿好连体防护服，拉上拉链
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student finishes putting on a coverall and zips it up.
shots.narration: 先穿好连体防护服，

shots.scene: 小研拿起头盔准备戴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up the helmet, ready to put it on.
shots.narration: 最后才戴头盔。

shots.scene: 小研按下电池盒开关，指示灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the switch on the battery pack and its lights come on.
shots.narration: 戴之前，一定先开机。

shots.scene: 关机状态的头罩套在小人头上，小人憋闷，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person icon wearing a hood with the fan switched off, looking breathless, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不开机就戴，会憋闷，有窒息危险。

shots.scene: 小研把手放在头盔进风口，感觉到风
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds her hand near the helmet's air outlet and feels the airflow.
shots.narration: 伸手感觉一下，有风再戴。

shots.scene: 电池盒上三个灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three indicator lights glow on the battery pack. No people.
shots.narration: 灯亮，说明电源接通。

shots.scene: 电池图标旁边一个时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon next to a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电池能用多久，以说明书为准。

shots.scene: 小研看手表，计划好实验时间
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her watch, planning her work time.
shots.narration: 实验时间要算在续航以内。

shots.scene: 小研双手撑开披肩，从头顶套下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student spreads the shroud with both hands and lowers it over her head.
shots.narration: 撑开披肩，从头顶套下去。

shots.scene: 小研戴好头盔，整理肩上的披肩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student settles the helmet and smooths the shroud over her shoulders.
shots.narration: 戴正头盔，把披肩拉平。

shots.scene: 小研在镜子前看披肩有没有卷起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks in a mirror that the shroud is not rolled up.
shots.narration: 照镜子，看披肩有没有卷边。

shots.scene: 小研双手托住头盔，从头上摘下，指示灯还亮着
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the helmet off her head while the battery lights are still on.
shots.narration: 摘的时候，风机保持运转，

shots.scene: 头盔放到架上，然后按下开关，拔下导线
shots.prompt_en: The helmet is placed on a stand, then the switch is pressed and the cable unplugged. No people.
shots.narration: 摘下放好，再关机、拔电池。

shots.scene: 小研戴着手套，用消毒湿巾擦拭头盔外壳
shots.prompt_en: Wearing gloves, the female graduate student wipes the helmet shell with a disinfectant wipe.
shots.narration: 每次用完，给头盔表面去污。

shots.scene: 旧披肩放进生物危害废物袋，旁边新披肩
shots.prompt_en: An old shroud goes into a biohazard bag, with a new shroud beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 披肩需要时就换新的。

shots.scene: 电池放在充电座上，灯一格一格亮起
shots.prompt_en: The battery pack sits in a charger and its lights fill up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 最后，电池充上电，

shots.scene: 整套装备整齐放回架上
shots.prompt_en: The whole respirator set is placed neatly back on the shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 下次拿来就能用。

shots.scene: 实验中，小研的电池盒红灯闪烁，发出提示音
shots.prompt_en: During work, the battery pack on the female graduate student flashes a red light and beeps.
shots.narration: 用着用着，报警或风变小了？

shots.scene: 小研盖好样品，停下手里的操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student caps her samples and stops working.
shots.narration: 先停手，盖好样品。

shots.scene: 小研在污染区伸手要摘头盔，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reaching to pull off her helmet inside the work area, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 别在污染区摘头罩。

shots.scene: 小研按出口路线走向更衣间，给王老师比手势
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks along the exit route to the changing room and signals to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 按程序退出，到指定区域再摘。

shots.scene: 王老师在记录本上登记，电池图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes in a blank logbook next to a battery icon crossed out.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，设备送检。

shots.scene: 三个小人图标：有胡子的、戴眼镜的、脸型特别的
shots.prompt_en: Three person icons: one with a beard, one wearing glasses and one with an unusual face shape. No people.
shots.narration: 宽松头罩不靠贴紧脸，

shots.scene: 三个小人都戴上送风头罩，各一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: All three person icons wear powered hoods, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有胡子、戴眼镜也能用。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研上课，旁边一个头罩图标和证书图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches the female graduate student next to a hood icon and a certificate icon.
shots.narration: 但必须培训合格后才能用。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表，旁边头罩和口罩两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank assessment form beside a hood icon and a mask icon.
shots.narration: 用哪种，由风险评估决定。

shots.scene: 日历翻页，一张旧规程变成新规程
shots.prompt_en: A calendar turns its pages and an old blank procedure sheet becomes a new one. No people.
shots.narration: 疫情时期的防护配置，

shots.scene: 王老师在电脑前查阅，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks information on a computer with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 是当时做法，以现行规定为准。

shots.scene: 三个图标：规定文件、评估表、说明书，指向一套防护装备
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a regulation document, an assessment form and a manual, pointing at a set of protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 看现行规定、评估结果和说明书。

shots.scene: 头盔外壳和披肩被涂成淡红色，表示污染
shots.prompt_en: The helmet shell and shroud are shaded light red to show contamination. No people.
shots.narration: 摘头罩时，外面都当作污染。

shots.scene: 小研只捏头盔后部摘下，脸离开披肩外面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes the helmet by holding only the back, keeping her face away from the outside of the shroud.
shots.narration: 手只碰规定的位置，脸别碰外面。

shots.scene: 头盔放进指定的去污区托盘
shots.prompt_en: The helmet is placed into a tray in a marked decontamination area. No people.
shots.narration: 放到指定位置，等去污。

shots.scene: 小研在感应水龙头下洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes her hands under a sensor tap.
shots.narration: 摘完马上洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现腰带、电池、头盔三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a belt, a battery pack and a helmet.
shots.narration: 先系腰带挂电池，先开机再戴。

shots.scene: 头盔架、消毒湿巾、充电座三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a helmet stand, a disinfectant wipe and a charger. No people.
shots.narration: 摘下再关机，去污又充电。

shots.scene: 报警灯、评估表、日历三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a warning light, an assessment form and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 风停就撤，按评估选，按现行规定做。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着送风头盔，隔着面罩向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a powered respirator helmet waves goodbye at the camera through the visor.
shots.narration: 风一直吹，安全常在，再见！
